title: AI Travel Agency
description: Experimental AI-powered travel agency assistant. A language model autonomously manages travel bookings from natural-language queries, deciding when to invoke MCP tools, with input and output guardrails. Postgraduate study project.

title: Florinda Eats
description: Food-delivery backend built as an event-driven microservices system: independent orders, payments, and fiscal-invoice services communicating over Kafka. Study project on Quarkus Messaging.

title: Showcase Expo app
description: Application showcasing a smart home device management system. The app allows users to view, control, and monitor connected devices using Bluetooth Low Energy (BLE) technology.

title: Econo Market
description: This platform allows users to view and share product prices across different markets, promoting collaboration among users to inform product prices in local supermarkets.
